research.title: Research & Publications
research.body: Members publish written analyses on companies, sectors, and macro themes — building a track record.

careers.title: Careers & Network
careers.body: Workshops, alumni talks, and prep for internships across markets, IB, and asset management.

home.joinBody: Open to every Bachelor student curious about finance — no prior experience required.

about.title: Who we are
about.intro: The Bachelors Finance Club is a student-run association at CentraleSupélec dedicated to financial education, market research, and career preparation for Bachelor students.
about.missionBody: We make finance accessible and rigorous. Through weekly sessions, published research, and a supportive community, we help students go from curious to competent — whatever their starting point.
activities: Written research on equities, sectors, and macro
about.historyBody: Founded by Bachelor students who wanted a serious yet welcoming place to learn markets, the club has grown into a home for anyone eager to understand how finance really works.
